# supervis

> DeepSeek V4-powered supervisor that drives Claude Code autonomously through software projects. Automatic model tiering (flash for routine steps, pro on escalation), self-correction when stuck, TOML config, cost budgets, full TUI with live output and message queuing.

## Docs

* [README](https://github.com/arikusi/supervis/blob/main/README.md) — install, usage, config, model switching, architecture
* [Changelog](https://github.com/arikusi/supervis/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) — version history
* [Full docs (single file)](https://github.com/arikusi/supervis/blob/main/llms-full.txt) — everything in one context-window-friendly file
* [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/supervis/) — package page

## Overview

supervis is a TUI tool that uses DeepSeek V4 as a supervisor to orchestrate Claude Code. You describe what you want, DeepSeek breaks it into steps, sends each step to Claude Code, and keeps going until the task is complete. Watch Claude work in real time. Type while the agent works.

supervis tiers its own thinking: routine steps run on `deepseek-v4-flash`, and it escalates to `deepseek-v4-pro` for hard architectural decisions or when Claude Code gets stuck and needs a re-plan. Configuration is TOML-based with global, per-project, and env var layers. Pin a model with `/model`, or let supervis tier automatically. Set cost budgets to cap spending. Export conversations to markdown or JSON.

## Quick start

```bash
pipx install supervis
cd myproject
supervis
```

Requires Claude Code CLI and a DeepSeek API key.
